page.overview:
Who is Tomono?

Tomono is a young man with short dark hair and wears glasses.

He is shown to be a caring person, expressing concern and telling "Kurose" to quit his job because he doesn't want him to die like his older brother.

Tomono is a childhood friend of Kurose and they used to play soccer in the same soccer team.

When Kurose was in Tokyo, he, Tomono and Michiko went swimming and took a picture together, with Tomono writing a message on its back, telling Kurose to call him again when he is in Tokyo.
